text:
leah: Heads-up 1  - Citrene onboarding health shows repeated tail latency on /v1/embed-search. Renewal touchpoint in 10d. We need a short evidence bundle + draft comms + provisional credit calc.
tom: paste the SLO and the numbers pls (p50/p95/p99 + uptime)
leah: SLA: 99.95% uptime; SLO (latency): 95% of requests < 100ms for /v1/embed-search. Last 7d: uptime 99.97%, p50=28ms, p95=220ms, p99=540ms. Breaches on 3 days (2 business days) -> potential credit trigger per contract.
andrew: likely tail from cold kv/cache misses + a couple autoscale events. I'll pull traces and the autoscaler logs. Bundle should include: timeseries, top traces, scaling events, and a one-page summary.
tom: credit calc reminder: our standard provisional formula = (breach_days / 7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. Need requests and avg token size in the breach windows.
andrew: quick ops commands i'll run:
```
redwood metrics export --service inference --route "/v1/embed-search" --since 7d --agg p50,p95,p99,uptime --by day > citrine-metrics.csv
redwood traces query --route "/v1/embed-search" --filter "latency>200" --limit 25
redwood infra events --service inference --since 7d --filter "autoscale" > autoscale.log
```
will attach top 5 traces + autoscale timeline.
legal-bot: automated notice: Please use "provisional" language in external comms. Credits are subject to verification and final audit per contract section 4.3. Link to clause: https://redwood.internal/contracts/clauses#4.3
slo-bot: automated: 2025-11-02T09:20Z - p95 exceeded 100ms on 3 days this rolling-7d. Incident ticket CS-3001 opened: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CS-3001
citrine-contact: thanks for flagging. we can run a 30min synthetic at 02:00 UTC tomorrow to help validate warmup. would that help avoid full credit?
leah: yes please. we'll schedule a canary toggle and ask for the synthetic run. plan: 1) request synthetic from customer, 2) enable prefix cache + one extra prewarmed replica for 24h canary, 3) measure 6h post-toggle, 4) compute provisional credit if breach persists. Deadline: bundle draft in 36h so CSM can review before renewal call.
tom: i'll compute provisional and "remediation-adjusted" credits and draft the customer note (1-pager + appendix). will include placeholders for token counts and exact windows.
andrew: on infra side i'll post trace snippets and autoscale graph. canary toggle scheduled 23:45 UTC tonight. will post 6h and 24h snapshots.
leah: assigning owners: tom (credit calc + customer note), andrew (traces + infra timeline + canary metrics), legal-bot (provisional wording), citrine-contact (confirm synthetic slot). i'll aggregate and send to legal for signoff before outreach.
citrine-contact: confirmed synthetic at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. we'll also run a short burst at start to simulate production traffic.
leah: perfect. communication strategy: offer provisional credit estimate + remediation timeline; propose to adjust final credit downward if warmup proves effective within 48h. any objections?
legal-bot: ensure we add audit window and data sources for verification (metrics CSV + traces + incident ticket). I'll review final wording.
tom: noted. aiming to upload draft bundle by 18:00 PST today.
leah: thanks team. lowering renewal risk if canary + synthetic reduce tails; otherwise proceed with standard credit process. closing loop in this thread once draft is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
